regions.merged_text: Marie Pastorino - 48 - of 1621 Parkview - Detroit, M. on way to Florida for health improvement, met serious trolley accident(Accident March 6) Spinal fraction - taken in stretcher to Hospital. Her sis- ter came to monastery - evening and enrolled her in Ser. Mass As. Next morning after enrollment ... (promising perpetually) ... Drs. and nurses - all were astonished. . . patient sat up - walked - is to con- tinue trip south next week. Some of them refuse to believe cure.

regions.merged_text: John Teahen - 17 - auto accident on 17th September last, badly broken leg - has been operated on yesterday for 3rd time. Drs. in Harper Hosp. think he will have to be in cast for at least a year. He is enrolled To-day - requested by Mrs. Schleuss - Episcopelian neighbor. 25th Drs. suprised now they hope. Sept. 2 - 1944 3rd cast removed Aug. 28 - last Monday leg is saved .... Father offers $20. for PP. Souls.
